name: ZettaServe
summary: Perth holding/tech group (ZettaServe Pty Ltd, ACN 106 003 490, renamed Zetta Pty Ltd 2021); acquired Highway 1 in 2007; its ISP arm became Zettagrid ~2010, ending ZettaServe's role as an ISP; company continues as a non-ISP holding.

events.details: Acquired by Zetta Pty Ltd — last live May 2014; 302 to zetta.com.au from Dec 2014.

refs.label: From Dec 2014 the domain redirects to the Zetta holding brand.
Same entity renamed Zetta; ISP arm became Zettagrid.
